svg.title: SPE Mines PetroBowl team polo, design 01

g.text: COLORADO SCHOOL OF MINES · SPE STUDENT CHAPTER
Navy piqué knit · gold, white and SPE-blue embroidery
Wearer's right chest, 3.5 in wide. Two gold trophies
flank an oil derrick inside a black-gold oil drop.
Wearer's left chest, 3 in wide, one-colour white
Right sleeve, 1 in tall, gold outline, black-gold fill.
Collar edge and both sleeve cuffs.
SPE MINES over a gold PETROBOWL wordmark,
